abstract: From 1969 to 1984, 58 patients with a diagnosis of testicular seminoma were seen and treated at the University of Kansas Medical Center. The median age was 34 years (range of 20 to 62 years). The American Joint Committee on Cancer Staging System was followed: stage I (34 patients); stage II (6); stage III (8); and stage IV (10). Forty-two patients had typical seminoma, and 16 had anaplastic histology. Nine patients had elevated B subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin, and nine had a history of cryptorchidism. Fifty-six patients received radiation treatment, and seven received chemotherapy with or without radiation. The median follow-up was 7 years (range 3 to 16 years). The overall disease-free (absolute) survival according to stage was: stage I, 91% (100%); stage II, 66% (80%); stage III, 75% (85%); and stage IV, 50% (50%). There were no late complications. The survival for patients with anaplastic histology or with elevated B subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin was not significantly different from that of typical seminoma.
abstract_ja: 1969年から1984年の間に、カンザス大学医療センターで精巣セミノーマと診断され治療を受けた58例を対象とした。年齢中央値は34歳(20～62歳)であった。米国癌合同委員会の病期分類システムに従い、病期I 34例、病期II 6例、病期III 8例、病期IV 10例であった。42例が典型的セミノーマ、16例が未分化型組織であった。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニットの高値が9例、停留精巣の既往が9例に認められた。56例が放射線療法を受け、7例が化学療法(放射線療法の併用の有無を問わず)を受けた。追跡期間中央値は7年(3～16年)であった。病期別の全体の無病(絶対)生存率は、病期I 91%(100%)、病期II 66%(80%)、病期III 75%(85%)、病期IV 50%(50%)であった。晩期合併症は認められなかった。未分化型組織またはhCGβサブユニット高値の患者の生存率は、典型的セミノーマの患者と有意差はなかった。
